title: URL Encoder/Decoder
h1: URL Encoder & Decoder — Percent-Encode Text Free
seoTitle: URL Encoder Decoder — Free Percent-Encoding Tool
description: Encode text for safe use in URLs or decode percent-encoded strings back to readable form. Runs entirely in your browser with correct handling of special characters.
intro: Turn any text into a URL-safe percent-encoded string, or reverse the process to see the original characters. Useful for query strings, redirects and debugging links — all done locally.
blurb: Percent-encode text for URLs or decode percent-encoded strings — free and private.

controls.label: Text or encoded string
controls.placeholder: Paste text to encode or a percent-encoded string to decode

howItWorks: Paste plain text and press Encode for URL to turn spaces and special characters into percent escapes.
Paste a percent-encoded string and press Decode URL text to restore the original characters.
The tool uses the browser’s encodeURIComponent and decodeURIComponent, so the result matches what web browsers expect.
examples: Encode a search query that contains spaces or punctuation before putting it in a link.
Decode a long query string from a browser address bar to read the parameters clearly.
Prepare a string that must survive inside a URL path or fragment.

faq.a: Percent-encoding replaces characters that are not allowed in a URL with a percent sign followed by two hexadecimal digits, so the string can travel safely in addresses and query parameters.

faq.q: Is anything sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Both encoding and decoding happen entirely in your browser. The text you enter stays on your device.
If a percent escape is incomplete or contains invalid hex digits the browser cannot decode it. The tool reports the problem instead of showing broken text.
